create_chexpert_dataset: create a CheXpertDataset instance to load chest radiograph data from a specified directory and split
get_default_labels: get the default list of 14 CheXpert radiograph finding labels using the static default_labels method
preprocess_csv: preprocess a CheXpert CSV DataFrame by extracting patient IDs, normalizing view, and applying subselect filters
retrieve_sample: retrieve a sample dictionary with image, labels, and metadata from the CheXpert dataset by index
get_dataset_length: get the total number of samples in the CheXpert dataset using the length method
